comparison.basis: Identical scripted native provider and 18-file fixture; current test overlaid temporarily on frozen baseline and removed after replay. No live-model inference.
comparison.interpretation: Removes false blocking and four unnecessary provider requests in this fixture. Does not establish average coding success, provider reasoning quality or model cost.

liveModelValidation.reason: No configured live provider credentials; no paid inference was authorized or invoked. Provider adapters were exercised offline with stubbed transport.
unmeasured: patch correctness across a representative real bug corpus
